nemeses.name: Prince of Gluttons

3-4 players: Devour two cards from the least expensive supply pile.

nemeses.rules:
* When a card is Devoured, place it on top of the devoured pile, even if the devoured pile is empty.
* Cards may be gained from the top of the devoured pile as if it were a supply pile.
* The players may look through the devoured pile at any time.
* Cards in the devoured pile cannot be Devoured.
* Prince of Gluttons does not start a Devour on an empty supply pile.
* When Prince of Gluttons would Devour a card from a supply pile that is empty Gravehold suffers 2 damage per card instead.
(Example: Devour two cards from a supply pile with only one card.)
* If all supply piles are empty except for the devoured pile, the players lose.
nemeses.setup: Place one gem from each gem supply, starting with the most expensive, faceup in a pile next to this mat. This pile is the devoured pile.

nemeses.name: Mist Revealed
nemeses.unleash: Resolve all of the "UNLEASH:" effects of fragments in play. Then, draw a card from the fragment deck and place it into play.
nemeses.increased_difficulty: RULES: At the beginning of the nemesis turn, resolve the "UNLEASH:" effect of the oldest fragment in play.
nemeses.rules:
When a fragment is discarded, place it in the fragment discard pile.
When the fragment deck is empty and a fragment would be drawn, shuffle the fragment discard pile facedown to form a new fragment deck.
If a fragment minion is silenced, only remove the silence token when that minon's Unleash: effect would resolve and ignore that effect.
When a player becomes exhausted, draw a card from the fragment deck and place it into play instead of Unleash twice.
If all of the fragment cards are in play, Mist succeeds at creating the ultimate Nameless and the players lose the game.
Mist Revealed has no maximum life.
nemeses.setup: None.

nemeses.name: Griefweaver
nemeses.unleash: Draw a card from the fetter deck and place it into play.
nemeses.increased_difficulty:
SETUP: Before placing fetters, destroy a supply pile.
RULES: Each fetter comes into play with 1 additional life.
nemeses.rules:
A supply pile is covered if there is a fetter on it.
Players cannot gain or destroy cards from covered supply piles.
If there are ever no uncovered supply piles, the players lose.
If the fetter deck is empty and a fetter would be placed into play, shuffle the fetter discard pile facedown to reform the fetter deck.
nemeses.setup:
When creating the supply, you may include at most 4 gem supply piles, 3 relic piles, or 5 spell piles. This does not allow you to have more than 9 supply piles.
Shuffle all of the fetter cards facedown to form the fetter deck.
Place fetters into play until there are four covered supply piles. If there are no uncovered gem supply piles, place fetters until there are five covered supply piles, then discard a fetter from a gem supply pile. Shuffle any extra fetters drawn back into the fetter deck. Gravehold cannot suffer damage during this setup.

nemeses.name: Risen Thrall
nemeses.unleash: Place a thrall into play.
nemeses.increased_difficulty: RULES: Each thrall comes into play with 2 additional life. When a thrall makes a player or Gravehold suffer damage, that player or Gravehold suffers 1 additional damage.
nemeses.rules:
During any player's main phase, that player may spend 2 Æ to flip over a thrall in play. If it is an illusion, discard it.
When the thrall deck is empty and you need to draw one, shuffle the discard pile with the Shambling Infantry and Soldier of Rot sides faceup to form the thrall deck.
When a faceup thrall is discarded, do not flip it over.
At the start of the nemesis turn, if there are 1/2/3/4 Soldiers of Rot in play, Gravehold suffers 1/1/2/4 damage.
At the start of the nemesis turn, if there are 1/2/3/4 Shambling Infantry in play, any player suffers 1/1/2/3 damage.
If there are twelve thralls in play and the nemesis Unleashes, Gravehold suffers 4 damage.
nemeses.setup:
Shuffle the thrall cards with the Shambling Infantry and Soldier of Rot sides faceup to form the thrall deck.
Place the Thrall Reminder card into play.

nemeses.name: Thief of Dreams
nemeses.unleash: Draw a card from the Dream deck and place it in space 1 of the Dream Mat.
nemeses.increased_difficulty: RULES: Both turn order cards are Delirium turn order cards. When a supply card is pushed to space 6, place it on the bottom of the Dream deck and any player suffers 3 damage instead of 2.
nemeses.rules:
When the Delirium turn order card is drawn, Unleash and then the Nemesis takes a turn as normal.
When a new card is placed on the Dream Mat, as needed move the other cards one space forward to make space for it.
When a supply card is pushed to space 6, place it on the bottom of the Dream deck and any player suffers 2 damage.
Cards on the Dream Mat are considered part of the supply. When an effect refers to a supply pile, it is not referring to the Dream Mat.
During any player's main phase, that player may spend 3 Æ to destroy a supply card on the Dream Mat.
When there are no supply cards on the Dream Mat, Unleash.
If the Dream deck is empty and there are no supply cards on the Dream Mat, the players win.
When a player becomes exhausted, Gravehold suffers 5 damage instead of Unleash twice.
nemeses.setup:
Replace a nemesis turn order card with the Delirium turn order card.
Set the Dream Mat next to this mat.
Set aside four copies of each relic and spell from each relic and spell supply pile. Set aside six copies of each gem from each gem supply pile except for the one with the lowest cost. Shuffle all of the set aside cards together and set them facedown to form the Dream deck. Place this next to the Dream Mat.
Unleash twice.

nemeses.name: Experiment 153
nemeses.unleash: Move any maw token two spaces forward toward the end of its track.

When you move a maw token forward onto a space with an effect, resolve that effect.
If a maw token starts to move forward any number of spaces while it's at the end of its track, instead resolve the effect of the space that it's currently on.
When a player would deal damage to Experiment 153, that player deals all of that damage to a single maw instead.
When a player deals 3 or more damage with one instance to a maw, move that maw token back one space.
When a maw token is on the first or fourth space of its track, it cannot be moved back.
When a maw is reduced to 0 life, discard that token and move another token back two spaces.
The players win when the Growth Mat has no maw tokens on it.
nemeses.setup:

Place the four maw tokens on the four starting spaces on the Growth Mat.
Move two different maw tokens one space forward.
Experiment 153 does not use the nemesis life dial. Instead, give each maw 20 life.

nemeses.unleash: Any player gains a corruption and places it on top of their deck. That player shuffles their discard pile into their deck.
nemeses.increased_difficulty: RULES: When a corruption is destroyed, place it into any player's discard pile instead of returning it to the corruption deck.
nemeses.rules:
* When a corruption is destroyed, place it on the bottom of the corruption deck.
* When a player would gain a corruption and the corruption deck is empty, Gravehold suffers 2 damage instead.
* At the start of each player's turn, before that player's casting phase, that player resolves all corruptions in their hand, in any order.
* At the end of each player's main phase, that player resolves all corruptions they drew during their turn.
* Corruptions may not be played at any other time.
* When a player gains a corruption, that player may not look at the corruption unless it is placed into their hand.
nemeses.setup: Shuffle all of the corruption cards together and place them facedown to form the corruption deck.

nemeses.name: Necroswarm
nemeses.unleash: Place a bramble into play at location 5.
nemeses.increased_difficulty: SETUP: Return to the box one Brambles Rush 1 card and one Brambles Rush 0 card from the bramble movement deck. Then, Unleash twice.
nemeses.rules:
At the start of the nemesis turn, the brambles rush Gravehold. When the brambles rush Gravehold, resolve the following:
* If there is at least one bramble in play, draw a bramble movement card and move each bramble that many spaces toward Gravehold. Otherwise, Unleash.
* When a bramble reaches Gravehold, discard it and Gravehold suffers 4 damage.
Brambles are minions that can only be dealt damage equal to or greater than the damage number at its location on the Bramble Invasion Track. If damage is dealt this way, discard it from play.
When the bramble movement deck is empty and a card would be drawn from it, shuffle the bramble movement card discard pile and place it facedown to form the bramble movement deck. Then, draw a card from the bramble movement deck.
nemeses.setup:
Place the Bramble Invasion Track next to this mat.
Shuffle all of the bramble movement cards together and place them facedown to form the bramble movement deck. Place the bramble reminder card into play.
Place a bramble into play at location 5.

nemeses.name: The Wailing
nemeses.unleash: The player with the Target token gains two Cracked Onyx. That player passes the Target token to the player on their left.
nemeses.increased_difficulty: RULES: When Shatter resolves, add 1 less power token to it. It costs players an additional 1 Æ to force The Wailing to lose a nemesis token.
nemeses.rules:
During any player's main phase, that player may spend 7 Æ to force The Wailing to lose a nemesis token. If you are playing solo with one mage, it costs 2 Æ less to force The Wailing to lose a nemesis token.
When a player would gain a Cracked Onyx and that supply pile is empty, that player suffers 1 damage instead.
nemeses.setup:
Add an additional supply pile consisting of twenty Cracked Onyx.
Give player 1 that Target token.
Place into play the version of Shatter that corresponds to your player count as indicated on the bottom of Shatter.
The Wailing gains one nemesis token.

nemeses.name: Knight of Shackles
nemeses.unleash: Knight of Shackles focuses its closed breach with the lowest focus cost.
nemeses.increased_difficulty: RULES: Knight of Shackles's breaches' focus cost is increased by 1 Æ.
nemeses.rules:
* During any player's main phase, that player may spend Æ equal to the focus cost of one of the Knight of Shackles' closed breaches to turn that breach 90° counterclockwise. Once one of Knight of Shackle's breaches is opened, it will remain open for the rest of the game.
* When Knight of Shackles opens a breach, resolve the effect listed on that breach.
** Breach I: Two different players each suffer 2 damage.
** Breach II: Place the most recently discarded minion in the nemesis discard pile back into play. (Ignore its PERSISTENT: effect this turn.)
** Breach III: Gravehold suffers 7 damage.
** Breach IV: Knight of Shackles succeeds in summoning its full skeletal legion. Gravehold is overrun and the players lose the game.
nemeses.setup:
* Place the Knight of Shackles breach mat next to this mat.
* Place the four Knight of Shackles breach tokens on the breach mat to their matching positions.

nemeses.name: Paradox of Myth and Bone
nemeses.unleash:
MYTH UNLEASH: If Myth has more life than Bone, Bone gains 3 life. Otherwise, Bone unleashes.
BONE UNLEASH: Gravehold or any player suffers 2 damage.
nemeses.increased_difficulty: RULES: "MYTH PERSISTENT:" effects and "BONE PERSISTENT: effects trigger on both nemesis turns.
nemeses.rules:
When the Myth turn order card is drawn, resolve all of Myth's powers and minions in play and draw a card from Myth's nemesis deck and place it into play in Myth's play area.
When the Bone turn order card is drawn, resolve all of Bone's minions in play and draw a card from Bone's nemesis deck and place it into play in Bone's play area if it is a minion.
On their turn, any player may spend 3 Æ to remove a power token from a power in play. The last power token on a card cannot be removed in this way.
Myth and Bone are considered two separate nemeses. The Myth nemesis dial will be used to keep track of Myth's life. The normal nemesis dial will be used to keep track of Bone's life.
Myth and Bone both have no maximum life.
When an effect affects the nemesis, the players choose which nemesis is affected.
When a player becomes exhausted, the nemesis with the lowest life gains 7 life instead of Unleash twice.
When Myth or Bone is reduced to 0 life, the players win. When there are no nemesis cards left in play or in either nemesis deck, the players win and the nemesis with the lower life is defeated. (See Errata section)
nemeses.setup:
Replace the nemesis turn order cards in the turn order deck with the Bone and Myth turn order cards.
When making the nemesis deck, you will make one deck for Myth and one deck for Bone. Use only Myth nemesis specific cards for Myth's deck and only Bone nemesis specific cards for Bone's deck. No basic or upgraded basic cards are used. For all player counts, use all of the tier 3 cards. For 1/2/3/4 players, use 3/4/5/5 tier 2 cards. For 1/2/3/4 players, use 2/3/4/5 tier 1 cards.
Place the Myth nemesis dial next to the normal nemesis dial, and set both of those dials to 40 life. For 1/2 players, Myth and Bone each gain 10 life.

nemeses.name: Rageborne
nemeses.unleash: Rageborne gains one Fury token.
nemeses.increased_difficulty: RULES: After Rageborne Strikes, it loses one Fury token instead of three.
nemeses.rules:
When Rageborne Strikes, resolve the following in order:
* Draw a card from the strike deck and resolve it.
* Shuffle that card back into the strike deck.
* Rageborne loses three Fury tokens.
At the end of the nemesis turn, if Rageborne has four or more Fury tokens, it Strikes once.
nemeses.setup:
Shuffle all of the Strike cards together and place them facedown to form the strike deck.
Rageborne gains one Fury token.

nemeses.name: Bishop: Returned
nemeses.unleash: Bishop: Returned gains a nemesis token.
nemeses.increased_difficulty: RULES: When reinforcements are summoned, Bishop: Returned loses 3 nemesis tokens instead of 4.
nemeses.rules:
At the end of the nemesis turn, if Bishop: Returned has 5 or more nemesis tokens, reinforcements are summoned. Reveal the top two cards of the nemesis deck. Place a minion revealed this way into play. Discard the remaining revealed cards. Then, Bishop: Returned loses 4 nemesis tokens.
When a nemesis card would be drawn and the nemesis deck is empty, shuffle all of the minions in the nemesis discard pile facedown to form a new nemesis deck. Then, draw a card from the nemesis deck. For the rest of the game, when a tier 1 minion enters play, Bishop: Returned gains 2 nemesis tokens. Additionally, when a tier 2 minion enters play, Bishop: Returned gains 1 nemesis token.
nemeses.setup:
Banish the Bishop: Returned specific cards in deck L2-BR that have art that matches the Bishop of Scrolls minions you named and placed in envelope 15.
When playing outside of the legacy campaign, there is no setup.

nemeses.name: Rust Amalgam
nemeses.unleash: Place the top card of the parasite deck facedown on the bottom of the deck of the player with the target token. Then, that player passes the target token to the player on their left.
nemeses.increased_difficulty: UNLEASH: Before passing the target token, the player with the target token destroys a card in their hand or discard pile.
nemeses.rules:
When the parasite deck is empty and a player would need to place a parasite on the bottom of their deck, the players lose.
When playing solo, when you pass the target token, place it on the nemesis mat. While the target token is on the nemesis mat, ignore effects that affect the player with the target token. When the target token is passed while it is on the nemesis mat, it is passed to you.
nemeses.setup:
Shuffle all of the parasite cards faceup to form the parasite deck.
The first player gains the target token.

nemeses.name: The Burning Kor
nemeses.unleash: Place two embers on the Burning Kor Movement Mat at a single random ignition point.
nemeses.increased_difficulty:
UNLEASH: Place three embers instead of two on the Burning Kor Movement Mat at a single random ignition point.
RULES: Embers move three spaces instead of two.
nemeses.rules:
At the start of the nemesis turn, move each ember two spaces along its path starting with the embers closest to Gravehold.
When an ember would move and cannot, it moves as far as possible and then deals 1 damage to the player or Gravehold in the space it would move into.
Embers are minions and have 1 life.
Consult the The Burning Kor player aid for information about damaging embers and movement on the Burning Kor Movement Mat.
nemeses.setup:
Place the Ember Reminder card into play.
Give each player a The Burning Kor player card.
Place the Burning Kor Movement Mat next to this mat. Place each player's mage token on this mat orthogonally adjacent to Gravehold.
Unleash.

nemeses.name: Maiden of Thorns
nemeses.unleash: Maiden of Thorns gains one nemesis token.
nemeses.increased_difficulty: RULES: When Maiden of Thorns Impales, if the nemesis tier is 2, that player or Gravehold suffers twice as much damage instead of 1 additional damage. If the nemesis tier is 3, that player or Gravehold suffers three times as much damage instead of 2 additional damage.
nemeses.rules:
* At the end of the nemesis turn, if Maiden of Thorns has two or more nemesis tokens, it Impales. Any player of Gravehold (based on the Thorn marker) suffers damage equal to the number of cards in the Thorn supply pile. That player or Gravehold suffers additional damage equal to the nemesis tier minus one. Maiden of Thorns loses two nemesis tokens, and Advance. Repeat this until Maiden of Thorns has 0 or 1 nemesis tokens.
* Advance means to flip the Thorn marker over and place it on the next most expensive supply pile. If there are no supply piles more expensive than the Thorn supply pile, move the Thorn marker to the least expensive supply pile instead.
* When the Thorn supply pile is empty, Advance.
* When all supply piles are empty, the players lose.
nemeses.setup:
* The supply must contain at least five supply piles with different costs.
* Destroy two cards in each gem supply pile.
* Place the Thorn marker Gravehold side up on the least expensive supply pile. The supply pile that the Thorn is on is the Thorn supply pile. When the nemesis tier is 2, replace this token with the "+1 damage" version of the token. When the nemesis tier is 3, replace this token with the "+2 damage" version of the token.

nemeses.name: The Blight
nemeses.unleash: Any player gains a Tainted Halo.
nemeses.increased_difficulty: SETUP: Remove two Tainted Halos from the Tainted Halo supply pile. The nemesis gains 1 nemesis token.
nemeses.rules:
At the end of the nemesis turn, if The Blight has 4 or more nemesis tokens, it taints the living: draw a card from the blighted deck, place it into play, and The Blight loses 3 nemesis tokens. Repeat this if The Blight has 4 or more nemesis tokens.
When a blighted is defeated, place it in the blighted discard pile.
When there are no cards in the blighted deck and one would be drawn, shuffle the blighted discard pile facedown to form the blighted deck. If a blighted would be drawn and there is no blighted deck or discard pile, Gravehold suffers 15 damage.
If a player would gain a Tainted Halo and there are none in the Tainted Halo pile, The Blight gains 2 nemesis tokens instead.
When a Tainted Halo is destroyed, return it to the Tainted Halo supply pile.
When a player becomes exhausted, that player discards their three most expensive cards in hand instead of Unleash twice.
nemeses.setup:
Add an additional supply pile consisting of a number of Tainted Halos equal to the number of players plus 5.
Shuffle the blighted cards facedown to create the blighted deck.

nemeses.name: Burrower
nemeses.unleash: Destroy the top card of any supply pile. If the supply has no cards in it, any player discards a card in hand instead.
nemeses.increased_difficulty: RULES: When a trap is resolved, resolve it twice.
nemeses.rules:
When a facedown trap is the top card of a supply pile during the nemesis turn, reveal and resolve it.
When a facedown trap card is the top card of a supply pile during a player turn, discard it.
When a player becomes exhausted, that player discards three cards in hand and one prepped spell instead of Unleash twice.
nemeses.setup:
Shuffle the trap cards facedown.
For each supply pile, place one trap card facedown at the bottom of that pile. Then, place two copies of the card for that supply pile faceup on top of that trap. Next, place a trap facedown on top of those two cards. Repeat this until there is only one copy of that supply card left. Set that card faceup on top of the pile.

nemeses.name: Magus of Cloaks
nemeses.unleash:
Magus of Cloaks gains two nemesis tokens.
OR
Gravehold suffers 2 damage.
nemeses.increased_difficulty: RULES: Magus of Cloaks can never have less than three nemesis tokens or more than nine nemesis tokens.
nemeses.rules:
* When Magus of Cloaks would be dealt damage, reduce that damage by the number of nemesis tokens he has. Then, Magus of Cloaks loses one nemesis token.
* Magus of Cloaks can never have less than two nemesis tokens or more than eight nemesis tokens.
nemeses.setup: Magus of Cloaks gains four nemesis tokens.

nemeses.name: Fortress
nemeses.unleash: Move the Fortress token forward one space on the Fortress Track.
nemeses.increased_difficulty: RULES: When Fortress moves to the 3p start space he gains 2 additional rubble tokens.
nemeses.rules:
At the start of each nemesis turn, Unleash.
When a player deals damage to Fortress, if the Fortress token is on the top section of the Fortress Track, that player deals 1 additional damage. If the Fortress token is on the bottom section of the Fortress Track, that damage is reduced by 3 and then 1 rubble token is discarded. Then, if Fortress has no rubble tokens, move the Fortress token to the top space of the Fortress Track.
Fortress cannot gain rubble while it is on the top section of the Fortress Track.
When the Fortress token moves from the top section of the Fortress Track to the bottom section, Fortress gains 3 rubble tokens.
Fortress can have any number of rubble tokens.
nemeses.setup:
Place the Fortress Track next to this mat.
Place the Fortress token on the start space corresponding to your player count on the Fortress Track. If you are playing with 1/2/3 players, Fortress gains 3 rubble tokens.
Place the Fortress Reminder card into play.

nemeses.name: Fountain of Souls
nemeses.unleash: Place three souls on the start space corresponding to your player count on the Fountain of Souls track.
nemeses.increased_difficulty:
RULES: When a soul is placed on the Fountain of Souls track, immediately move it one space clockwise around the Fountain of Souls Track.
UNLEASH: Place four souls instead of three on the start space corresponding to your player count on the Fountain of Souls Track.
nemeses.rules:
At the start of the nemesis turn, move each soul one space clockwise around the Fountain of Souls Track.
When the lantern has three fuel, any player may use the lantern during their main phase to discard up to five souls distributed among two adjacent spaces. Then, the lantern loses all of its fuel.
Souls cannot be damaged and are not minions.
nemeses.setup:
Place the Fountain of Souls Track next to this mat. Place the lantern token on the 0 space of the Lantern Charge Track.
Add an additional supply pile consisting of all the Soulfires. When playing with 3/4 players, the players collectively gain 1/2 Soulfires from the Soulfire supply pile.
Place two souls on the start space corresponding to your player count on the Fountain of Souls Track.
Place the Soul Reminder card into play.

nemeses.name: Herald of the End
nemeses.unleash: Resolve the "Unleash:" effect of the hydra card in play.
nemeses.increased_difficulty:
SETUP: Set Herald of the End's life to 14 instead of 10.
RULES:At the end of every turn, reset Herald of the End's life to 14 instead of 10.
nemeses.rules:
At the end of every turn, reset Herald of the End's life to 10.
When Herald of the End's life is reduced to 0, players do not win. Instead, place the hydra card that is in play into the hydra discard pile. Then, draw a card from the top of the hydra deck, and place it into play. Prevent all damage that would be dealt to Herald of the End for the rest of the turn.
If you would draw a card from the hydra deck and you cannot, the players win.
At the end of any player's turn, if Herald of the End has 1-5 life, place the hydra card in play on the bottom of the hydra deck and draw a card from the top of the hydra deck.
When the nemesis deck is empty, the players lose.
Minions do not resolve their persistent effect the turn they come into play.
When a player is exhausted, Herald of the End gains 2 nemesis tokens instead of Unleash twice.
nemeses.setup:
Shuffle the hydra cards facedown and place one into play faceup.
If you are playing with 1/2/3 players, Herald of the End gains 2/2/1 nemesis tokens.

nemeses.name: The Endless Decay
nemeses.unleash: The Endless Decay gains a nemesis token.
nemeses.increased_difficulty:
SETUP: Remove 2 power tokens from Deteriorate.
RULES: When Deteriorate resolves, add 1 power token less to it.
nemeses.rules:
At the end of The Endless Decay's turn, if it has 4 nemesis tokens or more, The Endless Decay refracts. Remove 4 nemesis tokens from The Endless Decay and resolve the nemesis main phase again. The Endless Decay can only refract once per turn.
During any player's main phase, they may pay 4 Æ to add a power token to Deteriorate.
Entropy cards do not resolve the turn they come into play.
Entropy cards cannot be removed from play.
If you would draw an entropy card and cannot, the players lose.
nemeses.setup:
Place into play the version of Deteriorate that corresponds to your player count as indicated on the bottom of Deteriorate.
Shuffle the entropy cards together facedown to form the entropy deck.

nemeses.name: Gate Witch
nemeses.unleash: Gate Witch games one nemesis token.
nemeses.increased_difficulty: RULES: When Gate Witch accelerates time, it loses three nemesis tokens instead of four nemesis tokens.
nemeses.rules: At the end of the nemesis turn, if Gate Witch has five or more nemesis tokens and there is exactly one nemesis turn order card in the turn order discard pile, it accelerates times: shuffle a nemesis turn order card into the turn order deck, and the Gate Witch loses four nemesis tokens.
nemeses.setup: Gate Witch gains one nemesis token.

nemeses.name: Paradox of Myth
nemeses.increased_difficulty: RULES: Each villager comes into play with 1 additional life and 1 shield.
nemeses.rules:
On their turn, any player may spend 3 Æ to remove a power token from a power in play. The last power token on a card cannot be removed this way.
When a villager is discarded, place it in the villager discard pile.
When the villager deck is empty, shuffle the villager discard pile facedown to form the villager deck.
When a villager would be placed into play and there are no cards in the villager deck or discard pile, resolve the "PERSISTENT:" effect of all the villagers in play.
Do not resolve the "PERSISTENT:" effects of villagers the turn they are placed into play.
Paradox of Myth has no maximum life.
nemeses.setup:
Shuffle all of the villagers facedown to form the villager deck.
Place two villagers into play.
Place the Myth Unleash token on the Unleash section of the nemesis mat with the starting side faceup.

nemeses.name: Horde-Crone
nemeses.unleash: Shuffle the trogg discard pile into the trogg deck. Draw a card from the trogg deck and place it into play.
nemeses.increased_difficulty: RULES: All troggs have three life instead of two life.
nemeses.rules:
* There are three types of troggs in the trogg deck: Orps, Yuds, and Zoms.
* When a trogg enters play, resolve the effect on that card equal to number of troggs in play of that trogg type. The first trogg has no effect.
* When a trogg is discarded, place it in the trogg discard pile.
(This is not the same as the nemesis discard pile.)
nemeses.setup: Shuffle all of the trogg cards together and place them facedown to form the trogg deck. Draw a card from the trogg deck and place it into play.

nemeses.name: Clouded Mesmer
nemeses.unleash: The player with the target token gains the top card of the compulsion deck. Then, that player passes the target token to the player on their left.
nemeses.increased_difficulty: SETUP: The supply must contain a gem that costs 6 Æ or more, a relic that costs 7 Æ or more, and a spell that costs 8 Æ or more.
nemeses.rules:
When you gain a compulsion card, place it faceup in front of your player mat. It stays there until it is returned to the compulsion deck.
If you would gain a compulsion card and the compulsion deck is empty, Gravehold suffers 3 damage.
Cards in the Develop zone are considered part of the supply when resolving compulsion cards.
When a player is exhausted, that player returns all compulsions in their play area to the bottom of the compulsion deck and Gravehold suffers 2 damage for each compulsion returned this way instead of Unleash twice.
nemeses.setup:
When setting up the supply you must have three gem supply piles, two relic supply piles and four spell supply piles.
Shuffle the compulsion cards and place them faceup next to the nemesis mat to form the compulsion deck.
Give any player the target token.

nemeses.name: Fate Shepherd
nemeses.unleash: Any player gains a card from the supply. That player or Gravehold suffers damage equal to the cost of that card minus 1.
nemeses.increased_difficulty: UNLEASH: After resolving the Unleash, destroy the least expensive card in the supply.
nemeses.rules: When a player becomes exhausted, the players collectively return three cards in hand that cost 3 Æ or more to the supply instead of Unleash twice.
nemeses.setup: None.

nemeses.name: Mother of Rust
nemeses.unleash:
Mother of Rust gains a nemesis token.
Draw a card from the rustborn deck and place it into play.
nemeses.increased_difficulty: RULES: When any number of rustborn are placed into play, place an additional rustborn into play.
nemeses.rules:
If there are no rustborn in play, place a rustborn into play.
At the end of the nemesis turn, if Mother of Rust has 4 or more nemesis tokens, the rustborn rush. Resolve all of the RUSH: effects on rustborn in play. Then, Mother of Rust loses 4 nemesis tokens. Only resolve this effect once per turn even if Mother of Rust has enough nemesis tokens to have the rustborn rush again.
When a rustborn is discarded, place it in the rustborn discard pile.
Prevent all damage dealt to Mother of Rust.
The players win the game when there are no rustborn in the rustborn deck and no rustborn in play.
When a player becomes exhausted, place two rustborn into play instead of Unleash twice. Do not activate the "RUSH:" effects of those rustborn this turn.
When a rustborn would be placed into play and the rustborn deck is empty, all rustborn in play gain 1 life. This can cause rustborn to have more than their maximum life.
nemeses.setup:
Shuffle the rustborn cards facedown to form the rustborn deck.
Place one rustborn into play.

nemeses.name: Paradox of Bone
nemeses.unleash:
Gravehold suffers damage equal to the difference between the values of the two tokens on the Bone track.
Move the token that is further along the track one space forward on the track.
nemeses.increased_difficulty: RULES: Cards in the supply that have the same type as the token that is furthest back on the Bone track cost an additional 1 Æ. If both tokens are on the same space, ignore this.
nemeses.rules:
Whenever a player gains a gem or a relic, move the gem/relic token forward one space on the track. Whenever a player gains a spell, move the spell token one space forward on the track.
When a player becomes exhausted, the players collectively discard four gems instead of Unleash twice.
nemeses.setup: Place the Bone track next to this mat. Place the gem/relic token and spell token on the 0 space of the track.

nemeses.name: Carapace Queen
nemeses.unleash: Place two husks into play.
nemeses.increased_difficulty: UNLEASH: Place three husks into play instead of two.
nemeses.rules:
* Each husk is a minion that has 1 life.
* When a husk is placed into play, place it in the next available space on the Husk Track.
* When a player deals damage to a husk, that player may suffer 1 damage to distribute the damage dealt over multiple husks.
* If Carapace Queen has fifteen husks in play and must place another into play, Gravehold suffers 1 damage instead.
nemeses.setup: Place the Husk Track next to this mat. Place two husks into play on the first two spaces of the Husk Track.

nemeses.name: Stonemonger
nemeses.unleash: Stonemonger gains a nemesis token.
nemeses.increased_difficulty: RULES: When Stonemonger incites a frenzy, it loses 3 nemesis tokens instead of 4 nemesis tokens.
nemeses.rules:
At the end of Stonemonger's turn, if it has 4 nemesis tokens or more, Stonemonger incites a frenzy. Draw the top card of the ravener deck and place it into play. Then, Stonemonger loses 4 nemesis tokens. Repeat this until Stonemonger has 3 nemesis tokens or less.
When a ravener is discarded, place it into the ravener discard pile.
If a card would be drawn from the ravener deck and it is empty, shuffle the ravener discard pile to form a new ravener deck. If a card would be drawn from the ravener deck and it and the ravener discard pile are empty, the players lose.
nemeses.setup:
When setting up the supply, only use six supply piles. None of your supply piles can be gems. (When playing an expedition, return any supply piles you don't use to your Barracks instead of banishing them.)
Add Stonemonger's three gem supply piles to the six supply piles you have chosen.
Shuffle the ravener cards together and place them facedown next to the nemesis mat to form the ravener deck.
If you are playing with 1/2/3 players, Unleash.

nemeses.name: Hollow Crown
nemeses.unleash: Resolve the Blood Magic effect of the acolyte with the highest life.
nemeses.increased_difficulty: UNLEASH: Resolve the Blood Magic effect of each acolyte in play instead of the acolyte with the highest life without those acolytes suffering damage from their Blood Magic effects.
nemeses.rules:
* Hollow Crow cannot be dealt damage.
* When there are no acolytes in play at the end of any turn, the players win the game.
* When an acolyte is discarded, place it in the acolyte discard pile and draw a new acolyte.
* When multiple Blood Magic effects would be resolved at the same time, resolve them in order starting with the acolyte that has been in play the longest.
* When a player is exhausted, Gravehold suffers 4 damage instead of Unleash twice. Resolve the rest of the on exhaust effects.
nemeses.setup:
* Shuffle all of the acolyte cards together and place them facedown to form the acolyte deck.
* Draw two cards from the acolyte deck and place them into play.
* When playing with beginner rules, discard the top card of the acolyte deck.

nemeses.name: Maggoth
nemeses.unleash: Place two maggots into play.
nemeses.increased_difficulty: RULES: When Maggoth Unleashes, place one fly and one maggot into play instead of two maggots.
nemeses.rules:
Each maggot is a minion that has 1 life.
Each fly is a minion that has 2 life. When a player deals exactly 1 damage to a fly, replace it with a maggot.
When a player deals damage to a maggot or fly, that player must deal damage to a maggot or fly in the topmost row of the Nest Mat. That player may distribute the damage dealt over any number of maggots or flies on the same row.
When a fly hatches, flip the bottommost maggot over to the fly side, if able.
When a maggot or fly is placed into play, place it in the bottommost row of the Nest Mat that has space for it.
When a row is filled, resolve the effect directly above that row.
nemeses.setup:
Place the Nest Mat next to this mat.
Place two maggots into play on the bottom row of the Nest Mat.

nemeses.name: Fenrix
nemeses.unleash: Fenrix gains one nemesis token.
nemeses.increased_difficulty: SETUP: Place a claw into play.
nemeses.rules:
At the end of the nemesis turn, if Fenrix has four or more nemesis tokens, place a claw into play and Fenrix loses two nemesis tokens. Repeat this until Fenrix has less than four nemesis tokens.
When a claw is discarded from play, place it facedown on top of the claw deck and return all Position tokens on that claw to the corresponding players.
During any player's main phase, that player may place their Position token on a claw, even if it's already placed on a claw.
Prevent all damage dealt to claws by players without a Position token on that claw.
When the claw deck is empty, the players lose.
nemeses.setup:
Each player gains a Position token that matches their player color.
Place the claw cards facedown to form the claw deck.
If you are playing with 1/2/3 players, the nemesis gains 2/2/1 nemesis tokens.

nemeses.name: The Wanderer
nemeses.unleash:
Any pylon gains 2 life
OR
Any player suffers 2 damage.
OR
The Wanderer gains 3 life.
nemeses.increased_difficulty: RULES: When a player deals damage to a Dampening Pylon, reduce that damage by 1.
nemeses.rules:
Reduce all damage that is dealt to The Wanderer by abilities and player cards to 1.
During any player's main phase, that player may spend any amount of Æ to deal an equal amount of damage to The Wanderer.
When a pylon is discarded from play, place it into the pylon discard pile.
nemeses.setup:
Place the four Dampening Pylons into play.
Then, each pylon suffers 1 damage.

nemeses.name: Corruption's Core
nemeses.unleash: Corruption's Core gains a nemesis token.
nemeses.increased_difficulty: RULES: Voidlings come into play with an additional 2 life.
nemeses.rules:
Spells cast from a breach with a Void token on it deal 2 additional damage and the nemesis Unleashes in addition to any other effects the breach has.
Breaches with a Void token on them cannot be destroyed.
At the end of the nemesis turn, if Corruption's Core has 3 nemesis tokens or more, Corruption's Core beckons. Draw a card from the voidling deck and place it into play. Then, Corruption's Core loses 3 nemesis tokens. Repeat this until Corruption's Core has 2 nemesis tokens or less.
When a voidling is discarded, place it into the voidling discard pile.
If you would draw a voidling and the voidling deck is empty, shuffle the voidling discard pile facedown to create a new voidling deck.
If you would draw a voidling and the voidling deck and discard pile are both empty, the players lose.
nemeses.setup:
Shuffle the voidling cards facedown to create the voidling deck. Place the voidling deck next to the nemesis mat.
Each player places a Void token on their lowest numbered breach. If you are playing with 1/2 players, Corruption's Core gains 2 nemesis tokens.

nemeses.name: Thrice-Dead Prophet
nemeses.unleash: Thrice-Dead Prophet gains 5 life. Then, if it has 60 or more life, it gains one nemesis token.
nemeses.increased_difficulty: SETUP: Thrice-Dead Prophet gains 15 life.
nemeses.rules:
* At the end of the nemesis turn, if Thrice-Dead Prophet has four or more nemesis tokens, discard the top card of the nemesis deck and Thrice-Dead Prophet loses four nemesis tokens.
* Thrice-Dead Prophet has no maximum life.
* When Thrice-Dead Prophet has 99 or more life, it ascends to immortality and the players lose.
* When the nemesis deck is empty, the Thrice-Dead Prophet has completed the final ritual and the players lose.
nemeses.setup: None.

nemeses.name: The Coven
nemeses.unleash: Remove 1 power token from either Diatribe of Despair or Melody of Madness.
nemeses.increased_difficulty: RULES: After Diatribe of Despair or Melody of Madness finishes resolving, Unleash twice.
nemeses.rules:
Prevent all damage dealt to The Coven.
Do not discard Diatribe of Despair or Melody of Madness even if one of the witches is defeated.
Daughter of Doom and Matron of Malice are minions and witches.
When Daughter of Doom or Matron of Malice is defeated, turn it facedown. When both Daughter of Doom and Matron of Malice are facedown, the players win the game.
nemeses.setup: Place Daughter of Doom and Matron of Malice into play. Then, place into play the correct version of Diatribe of Despair and Melody of Madness based on player count.

nemeses.name: The Infecter
nemeses.unleash: If the Infecter has 0 nemesis tokens, it gains a nemesis token, then reveal the top card of the infection deck, and the player with the fewest infections gains that infection. Otherwise, each player resolves all of their infections, and The Infecter loses a nemesis token.
nemeses.increased_difficulty: SETUP: The players collectively gain three infections.
nemeses.rules:
Infections stay in front of players permanently.
If a player would gain an infection and cannot, each player resolves all of their infections instead.
When a player is exhausted, any player gains two infections instead of Unleash twice.
nemeses.setup: Shuffle all of the infection cards together and place them facedown to form the infection deck.

nemeses.name: The Wrath
nemeses.unleash: The Wrath gains 1 nemesis token.
nemeses.increased_difficulty: SETUP: Place the Wrath Track into play with the increased difficulty side faceup.
nemeses.rules:
At the end of the nemesis turn, if The Wrath has 4 or more nemesis tokens, it rampages: Gravehold suffers 7 damage and The Wrath loses 3 nemesis tokens. Repeat this if The Wrath has 4 or more nemesis tokens.
When a player deals damage to the nemesis, prevent that damage, advance the strike token an amount of spaces on the Wrath Track equal to the amount of damage prevented this way, and resolve the effect the token lands on.
Do not resolve effects the strike token passed over but did not land on.
If the token would move past the space 14, instead place it on space 14 and do not move it anymore from that instance of damage.
nemeses.setup:
Place the Wrath Track into play with the normal difficulty side faceup. Place the strike token on space 0.
Unleash.

nemeses.name: Infested Mutation
nemeses.unleash: Resolve the effect of the highest number level on the Miasma Track where globules are.
nemeses.increased_difficulty: RULES: When a player defeats a non-globule minion, place 2 globules on the Miasma Track.
nemeses.rules:
Each globule is a minion that has 1 life.
When you would place a globule onto the Miasma Track, place it in the next available space on the lowest numbered level on the Miasma Track.
When a player deals damage to a globule, that player must deal damage to a globule in the highest numbered level of the Miasma Track. That player may distribute the damage dealt over any number of globules on the same level.
The last globule on level 1 cannot be discarded.
Oozes do not resolve their persistent effect the turn they come into play.
When an ooze is discarded, place it into the ooze discard pile.
If you would draw an ooze but the ooze deck is empty, shuffle the ooze discard pile facedown to reform the ooze deck.
When a globule would be placed into play and there are no available spaces on the Miasma Track, Gravehold suffers 1 damage instead.
nemeses.setup:
Place the Miasma Track next to the nemesis mat.
Place 4 globules onto the Miasma Track. If you are playing with 1/2 players, place 2 more globules onto the Miasma Track.
Shuffle the ooze cards facedown to form the ooze deck, and set it next to the Miasma Track.

nemeses.name: Absorbing Wraith
nemeses.unleash: Gravehold suffers 1 damage for each card in stasis. If three or fewer cards are in stasis, Freeze a card.
nemeses.increased_difficulty: RULES: Gaining cards in stasis costs an additional 1 Æ.
nemeses.rules:
When a card is placed into stasis, place it next to this mat.
During any player's main phase, that player may spend Æ to place that many Æ tokens on a card in stasis. When a card in stasis has Æ tokens on it equal to its cost plus 2, the current player gains it. Aether that can only be used to gain cards can be used on cards in stasis.
Freeze a card means to place the top card of the supply pile with the Freeze token into stasis and Advance.
Advance means to place the Freeze token on the next most expensive supply pile. If there are no supply piles more expensive than the supply pile with the Freeze token, move the Freeze token to the least expensive supply pile instead.
Cards in stasis cannot be developed.
Cards in stasis are not in the supply.
When the supply pile with the Freeze token on it is empty, Advance.
When all supply piles are empty, the players lose.
When a player is exhausted, destroy all of the cards in the two least expensive supply piles instead of Unleash twice.
nemeses.setup:
Place the Freeze token on the least expensive supply pile.
Freeze a card. If playing with 1-3 players, Freeze an additional card.

nemeses.name: Bishop of Scrolls
nemeses.unleash: Draw a card from the unnamed deck and place it into play.
nemeses.increased_difficulty: RULES: Each unnamed comes into play with 2 additional life.
nemeses.rules:
When an unnamed is placed into play, do not resolve its "PERSISTENT:" effect during the nemesis main phase this turn.
When an unnamed is discarded, place it in the unnamed discard pile.
When the unnamed deck is empty and an unnamed would be drawn, shuffle the unnamed discard pile facedown to form a new unnamed deck.
If there are no cards in the unnamed deck or discard pile when an unnamed would be drawn, resolve the "PERSISTENT:" effect of each unnamed in play.
If there are ever no unnamed cards in play, no cards in the unnamed discard pile, and no cards in the unnamed deck, the players lose.
At the end of the game, if there are eight or more cards under this mat, randomly banish cards until there are seven cards remaining.
At the end of the game, if there are fewer than five cards under this mat, resolve the "PERSISTENT:" effect of the unnamed with the most letters in its name until there are five cards under this mat.
At the end of the game once there are five to seven cards under this mat, place all of the cards under this mat into envelope 15 and reseal the envelope.
nemeses.setup:
Place the unnamed deck facedown next to this mat.
Place an unnamed into play and resolve its "IMMEDIATELY:" effect. Place another unnamed into play and resolve its "IMMEDIATELY:" effect.
In a 1/2/3 player game, place a third unnamed into play and resolve its "IMMEDIATELY:" effect.

nemeses.name: The Reliquary
nemeses.unleash: Remove 1 power token from any obsession.
nemeses.increased_difficulty: SETUP: Draw an obsession and place it into play. Add 2 power tokens to it for each player in the game, in addition to the POWER number shown on the card (see Rulings#The_Reliquary).
nemeses.rules:
Obsessions have no maximum number of power tokens.
Cataclysms do not resolve their PERSISTENT: effects the turn they come into play.
When a cataclysm is discarded, place it in the cataclysm discard pile.
The top card of the cataclysm deck is always revealed.
When the cataclysm deck is empty, shuffle the cataclysm discard pile facedown to form a new cataclysm deck.
If you would draw a cataclysm and can't, the players lose the game.
nemeses.setup:
Shuffle all of the obsession cards together and place them facedown to form the obsession deck. Draw two obsessions and place them into play. Add 2 power tokens to each obsession for each player in the game, in addition to the POWER number shown on the card.
Shuffle all of the cataclysm cards together and place them facedown to form the cataclysm deck.

nemeses.name: Erythiza, Consumed
nemeses.unleash: Resolve the effect of the space of the Corruption Track that the city token is on.
nemeses.increased_difficulty: RULES: When the damage token reaches the end of the Damage Track, you may not choose for any player to gain 2 Æ tokens. You must choose to move the city token back up to two spaces on the Corruption Track instead.
nemeses.rules:
While the Mega Breach is closed, prevent all damage to Erythiza, Consumed. When a player would deal damage to Erythiza, Consumed, increase the Damage Track by the amount of damage dealt. When the damage token reaches the end of the Damage Track, immediately reset the damage token to 0 and either move the city token back up to two spaces on the Corruption Track or any player gains 2 Æ tokens. Once the damage token is reset, resume tracking the instance of damage.
During each player's main phase, that player may spend Æ equal to the current focus cost of the Mega Breach to rotate it clockwise one side. When a player does this, that player increases the Damage Track by 2.
The Mega Breach cannot be rotated counterclockwise when the focus cost is 2 Æ.
When a player spends 6 Æ to rotate the Mega Breach, it is opened. Flip the Mega Breach over. Read the rules written on it. Also, flip the Corruption Track over and place the city token on the one space there. Read the additional rules written there as well.
When a player becomes exhausted, players collectively discard four cards instead of Unleash twice.
If the nemesis would draw a card and the nemesis deck is empty, the players lose.
nemeses.setup:
Place the Corruption Mat next to the nemesis mat. Place the city token on the start space of the Corruption Track.
Place the damage token on the 0 of the Damage Track that corresponds to your player count on the Corruption Mat.
Place the Mega Breach next to the Corruption Mat with the closed side faceup and the 2 Æ focus cost aligned with the arrow on the Corruption Mat.

nemeses.name: Spawning Horror
nemeses.unleash: Breeding Chamber gains 3 life.
nemeses.increased_difficulty: UNLEASH: Breeding Chamber gains 5 life instead of 3.
nemeses.rules:
At the end of the nemesis turn, if Breeding Chamber has 11 or more life, it imbues a pod: draw a card from the pod deck, place it into play, and Breeding Chamber loses 10 life. Repeat this until Breeding Chamber has 10 or less life.
When a pod is discarded, place it in the pod discard pile. (This is not the same as the nemesis discard pile.)
When the pod deck is empty, shuffle the pod discard pile to form a new pod deck.
When there are seven pods in play, Spawning Horror completes its metamorphosis and the players lose.
nemeses.setup:
Place the Breeding Chamber card into play with 4 life. When playing with four players, Breeding Chamber starts the game with 1 life.
Shuffle all of the pod cards together and place them facedown to form the pod deck.

nemeses.name: Bladius
nemeses.unleash: The player with the fewest opened breaches suffers 2 damage.
nemeses.increased_difficulty: SETUP: Bladius starts the game with 90 life.
nemeses.rules: If Bladius would draw a card and cannot, it escapes and the players lose.

nemeses.name: Xaxos: Ascended
nemeses.unleash: Draw a spell from his spell deck and put it onto the leftmost breach with no spell prepped to it. If all of his breaches have a spell prepped to them already, cast the drawn spell instead.
nemeses.increased_difficulty: SETUP: After the spell deck is set up, destroy the top two cards of the spell deck. Then, Xaxos: Ascended Concentrates twice.
nemeses.rules:
At the start of the nemesis turn, Xaxos: Ascended casts all of his prepped spells in order from left to right. Place cast spells facedown on the bottom of the spell deck.
During any player's main phase, that player may lose charges equal to the cost of one of Xaxos: Ascended's prepped spells to place it facedown on the bottom of the spell deck.
When Xaxos: Ascended CONCENTRATES, place the top card of the concentrate deck facedown on the bottom of the spell deck.
When Xaxos: Ascended would CONCENTRATES and the concentrate deck is empty Unleash instead.
When a player is exhausted, Gravehold suffers 5 damage instead of Unleash twice. Resolve the rest of the exhaust effects.
nemeses.setup:
Place Xaxos: Ascended's breach mat next to this mat.
Divide Xaxos: Ascended's spell cards by cost. Shuffle each cost separately. Place the 5-cost cards facedown next to the breach mat where it says "Concentrate Deck." Place the 4-cost cards facedown on top of the 5-cost cards. Place the 3-cost cards facedown on top of the 4-cost cards. This is the concentrate deck. Place the top five cards of the concentrate deck facedown next to the mat where it says "Spell Deck." These cards are the spell deck.

nemeses.name: Maelstrom: Risen
nemeses.unleash: Draw a card from the beacon deck and place it into play.
nemeses.increased_difficulty: RULES: When Maelstrom: Risen's Assault turn order card is drawn and Gravehold suffers damage, Gravehold suffers 2 additional damage.
nemeses.rules:
When Maelstrom: Risen's Assault turn order card is drawn, Gravehold suffers 1 damage for each beacon in play. Then, Maelstrom: Risen takes a turn as normal. The Assault turn order card is considered a nemesis turn order card.
When a beacon is discarded, place it in the beacon discard pile next to the beacon deck. (This is not the same as the nemesis discard pile.)
When the beacon deck is empty and a card would be drawn from it, shuffle the beacon discard pile and place it facedown to form the beacon deck.
When there are ten beacons in play, Maelstrom: Risen opens a massive, destructive breach and the players lose.
nemeses.setup:
Shuffle all of the beacon cards together and place them facedown to form the beacon deck.
Draw two cards from the beacon deck and place them into play. Do not resolve any "IMMEDIATELY:" effects on those cards.
Replace one of the nemesis turn order cards in the turn order deck with Maelstrom's Assault turn order card.

nemeses.name: Deathmind
nemeses.unleash: Remove one power token from Sever Link.
nemeses.increased_difficulty: RULES: Players may spend 6 Æ or lose 5 pulse tokens to establish a neural bridge instead of 5 Æ or 4 pulse tokens.
nemeses.rules:
Players cannot gain the last card in a supply pile.
During any player's main phase, that player may spend 5 Æ or lose 4 pulse tokens to establish a neural bridge with Brama and place a Bridge token in between any two orthogonally adjacent supply piles.
Bridge tokens cannot be placed between two supply piles which already have a Bridge token.
Supply piles with Bridge tokens between them are connected. Two supply piles are connected if a path can be traced from one supply pile to the other via Bridge tokens.
When a player gains a card from a supply pile not connected to the first supply pile in the top row, that player suffers 2 damage.
nemeses.setup:
Arrange the supply in a three by three grid. Place the piles so that the gems start the top row, then relics, and finally spells. Within each card type, arrange the piles by cost, least expensive to most expensive.
Read the additional rules on the other side of this mat for information about Bridge tokens. Then, choose six spaces orthogonally between supply piles, and place a Bridge token in each of those six spaces. Place them so that each token is between only two piles, and there is at most one token between each two piles.
Place Sever Link into play with three power tokens.

nemeses.name: Fungal Mesh
nemeses.unleash: Fungal Mesh gains one nemesis token.
nemeses.increased_difficulty: Rules: When a player must cast a spell at the end of the nemesis turn, that spell deals 1 additional damage.
nemeses.rules:
At the end of the nemesis turn, if Fungal Mesh has two or more nemesis tokens, it possesses a player:
* If there are no prepped spells, Gravehold suffers 4 damage.
* If there is at least one prepped spell, any player casts a prepped spell. The damage that spell deals must be dealt to Gravehold or any player instead of a minion or the nemesis. If a spell that costs 0 Æ was cast this way, destroy it.
* Fungal Mesh loses two nemesis tokens.
* Repeat this until Fungal Mesh has one or less nemesis tokens.

nemeses.name: Maelstrom
nemeses.unleash: Gravehold suffers 3 damage.
nemeses.rules:
When Assist resolves, draw the top card of the Assist deck and resolve it. Then, place it in the Assist discard pile. (This is not the same as the nemesis discard pile.)
When the game ends, resolve the last card in the Assist deck, if able. Then, continue reading the front of Legacy deck card L03.
nemeses.setup:
Place the Assist deck without shuffling it next to this mat facedown.
Draw the top card of the nemesis deck and place it into play.

nemeses.name: Haze Fiend
nemeses.unleash: Haze Fiend gains one nemesis token.
nemeses.increased_difficulty: Rules: When a player must cast a spell at the end of the nemesis turn, that spell deals 1 additional damage.
nemeses.rules:
At the end of any nemesis turn in which Haze Fiend has two or more nemesis tokens, it fractures a Crystal:
* Any player places a flawed sticker on one of the non-flawed Crystals in their hand or discard pile and suffers 2 damage.
* If no player has a non-flawed Crystal in their hand or discard pile, place a flawed sticker on a non-flawed Crystal in the destroyed pile. The player whose name is on that Crystal suffers 2 damage.
* If no sticker was able to be placed in this way, any player suffers 2 damage.
* Haze Fiend loses two nemesis tokens.
* Repeat this until Haze Fiend has one or less nemesis tokens.
Flawed Crystals will remain flawed throughout the remaining games of Aeon's End: Legacy. When playing a Legacy character outside of this campaign, use non-flawed Crystals.
Players must use the flawed or non-flawed Crystals bearing their names to build their starting deck and hand in all subsequent games of Aeon's End: Legacy. Do not add flawed stickers if there are none left.
Do not replay this Chapter if you lose this game.
nemeses.setup: Each player writes their name at the bottom of each of their Crystals.

nemeses.name: Brama (Legacy of Gravehold)
nemeses.unleash: Draw a mage attack card and resolve it. Then, place it in the mage attack discard pile.
nemeses.increased_difficulty: None.
nemeses.rules: When the mage attack deck is empty, shuffle the mage attack discard pile facedown to form a new mage attack deck.
nemeses.setup: Shuffle the mage attack cards facedown to form the mage attack deck.

nemeses.name: Z'hana (Legacy of Gravehold)
nemeses.unleash: Draw a mage attack card and resolve it. Then, place it in the mage attack discard pile.
nemeses.increased_difficulty: None.
nemeses.rules: When the mage attack deck is empty, shuffle the mage attack discard pile facedown to form a new mage attack deck.
nemeses.setup: Shuffle the mage attack cards facedown to form the mage attack deck.

nemeses.name: Szalony Kotokronikarz
nemeses.unleash: Rozpatrz wierzchnią kartę z talii Wspomnień (jeśli to możliwe), następnie umieść jedną Księgę w grze.
nemeses.increased_difficulty: WYZWOLENIE: Umieść dwie Księgi w grze, zamiast jednej.
nemeses.rules:
Za każdym razem, gdy odrzucisz kartę Mocy z gry, wstaw ją do talii Wspomnień.
Gdy dobierzesz karty Mocy lub Ataku Królowej Roju, umieść w grze 1 Księgę, a następnie wstaw dobraną kartę do talii Wspomnień.
Gdy dobierzesz kartę Poplecznika Królowej Roju, rozpatrz atak Ksiąg – gracze oraz Gravehold otrzymują wspólne tyle obrażeń, ile Ksiąg znajduje się w grze. Następnie wstaw dobraną kartę do talii Wspomnień.
Każda Księga jest Poplecznikiem z tyloma punktami życia, ile Ksiąg znajduje się aktualnie w grze. Gdy gracz zadaje obrażenia Księdze, ten gracz może otrzymać 1 obrażenie, aby rozdzielić zadawane obrażenia na kilka Ksiąg.
nemeses.setup:
Szalony Kotokronikarz nie ma własnych kart Nemesis, zamiast tego używa kart Królowej Roju. Wykorzystuje też żetony Karaczanów Królowej Roju. Po przygotowaniu talii Nemesis odłóż wierzchnią kartę zakrytą na bok, tworząc talię Wspomnień.
Umieść w arkuszu Szalonego Kotokronikarza 2 żetony Karaczanów. W grze przeciwko temu Nemesis symbolizują one Księgi Kotokronikarza.

nemeses.name: Kusiciele Okazji
nemeses.unleash: Przesuń żeton Trofeum na kolejną kartę na rynku zasobów. Następnie gracz z najmniejszą liczbą żetonów Nemezis dobiera 1 żeton Nemezis.
nemeses.increased_difficulty: Kusiciele Okazji rozpoczynają z 70 punktami życia.
nemeses.rules:
* Gdy gracz pozyskuje kartę oznaczoną żetonem Trofeum, pozyskuje jej 2 kopie, następnie przesuwa żeton Trofeum na kolejną kartę na rynku zasobów.
* Gdy gracz pozyskuje kartę sąsiadującą z kartą oznaczoną żetonem Trofeum, wydaje na nią o 1 Æ mniej, a następnie przesuwa żeton Trofeum na kolejną kartę na rynku zasobów.
* Jeśli żeton Trofeum był na ostatniej karcie, a gracz musi go przesunąć, przesuwa go na pierwszą kartę.
* W Fazie Dobierania każdy gracz otrzymuje po 1 Obrażeniu lub dobiera o 1 kartę mniej za każdy posiadany żeton Nemezis (w dowolnej kombinacji).
* W Fazie Głównej gracz może wydać dowolną ilość Æ, aby poruszyć żeton Nemezis na torze Okazji o 1 pole za każdy wydany Æ. Gdy gracz poruszy żeton na ostatnie pole, rozpatrz jego efekt ("Odrzuć wszystkie posiadane żetony Nemezis lub dodaj po 1 żetonie Mocy na każdą kartę Mocy".)
nemeses.setup:
Kusićiele Okazji nie mają własnych kart Nemezis, zamiast tego używają kart Megiery Bram. Gdy jakiś efekt odnosi się do Megiery Bram, rozpatruj go tak, jakby odnosił się do Kusićieli Okazji.
Gdy jakiś efekt odnosi się do liczby żetonów Nemezis posiadanych przez Megierę Bram, rozpatruj go tak, jakby odnosił się do liczby żetonów Nemezis posiadanych w sumie przez graczy.
Umieść żeton Trofeum na najtańszej karcie Klejnotu na rynku zasobów.
Umieść żeton Nemesis na pierwszym od lewej polu toru Okazji.
Żetony Trofeum i Nemezis, a także Nemezis Megiera Bram znajdziesz w grze Aeon's End: Wieczna Wojna.

nemeses.name: The Terror in Brass
nemeses.unleash: If Regeneration is in play, The Terror in Brass gains 5 life. Otherwise, advance the Worldsplitter Track.
nemeses.increased_difficulty: RULES: Place the Worldsplitter Track into play with the increased difficulty side faceup.
nemeses.rules:
When every space on the Armor Chart is covered, The Terror in Brass is vulnerable.
When The Terror becomes vulnerable, place the Regeneration power card into play if it isn't already in play.
Double all damage dealt to The Terror while it is vulnerable.
When a player deals damage to The Terror while The Terror is not vulnerable, reduce that damage to 1.
During any player's main phase, that player may spend 3 Æ to place a nemesis token on an uncovered space on the Armor Chart and resolve its effect.
When the Worldsplitter Track is advanced, move The Terror in Brass token up one space on the Worldsplitter Track and then resolve the effect of that space.
nemeses.setup:
Place the mat with the Worldsplitter Track and Armor Chart next to this mat, normal difficulty side up.
Place a nemesis token on the "Cast any player's prepped spell" space of the Armor Chart. Place The Terror in Brass token on the Start space of the Worldsplitter Track.
Set aside the Regeneration power next to this mat faceup.

nemeses.name: The Timeless
nemeses.unleash: The Timeless gains one nemesis token.
nemeses.increased_difficulty: RULES: Finalities come into play with an additional 1 life. When resolving a Finality's PERSISTENT: effect, players may not exile the top card of their discard pile.
nemeses.rules:
At the end of The Timeless's turn, if it has three or more nemesis tokens, place a Finality into play, and The Timeless loses three nemesis tokens. Repeat this until The Timeless has two or less nemesis tokens.
When a Finality is defeated, return it to the Finality pile.
If a Finality would be placed into play and there are none in the Finality pile, Gravehold suffers 10 damage instead.
When a card is exiled, place it faceup on top of the exiled pile, even if the exiled pile is empty.
Cards may be gained from the top of the exiled pile, as if it were a supply pile, by paying their cost plus 1 Æ.
The exiled pile is not considered part of the supply.
The players may look through the exiled pile at any time, but they may not rearrange it.
nemeses.setup:
Each player places a Curse of Exhaustion card in their discard pile.
Place a card from the most expensive supply pile faceup next to this mat. This card is the start of the exiled pile.
Place the Finality cards in a faceup pile next to this mat to form the Finality pile.

nemeses.name: Arachnos
nemeses.unleash: Move the Arachnos token one space forward on the Ritual Track.
nemeses.increased_difficulty: SETUP: Arachnos gains two nemesis tokens and Unleash twice.
nemeses.rules:
Players may spend Æ equal to the number shown on the Ritual Track for the current position of the Arachnos token to move it back one space on the Track.
When the Arachnos token reaches the end of the Ritual Track or Arachnos has more than eight nemesis tokens, the ritual is complete.
When the players would win the game and World Devourer has not entered play yet, Arachnos loses a nemesis token and the ritual is complete.

Find the World Devourer card that has a tier number equal to the number of nemesis tokens Arachnos has and place it into play. Flip over the Ritual Track.

nemeses.setup:

Place the World Devourer cards next to this mat in ascending order with the lowest tier on top.

nemeses.unleash: Pupil of Oblivion gains 4 life.

When a player would be dealt a card from the vortex and can't, Gravehold suffers 4 damage instead.

nemeses.setup:

Place 4/5/6/7 Crystals for 1/2/3/4 players from the box next to this mat to form the vortex deck.
Place the Pupil of Oblivion into play with 2 life.

nemeses.unleash: Twice-Dead Prophet gains 2 life and one nemesis token.
nemeses.increased_difficulty: SETUP: Twice-Dead Prophet gains 20 life.

When a power is played off a prophecy, do not remove any power tokens from it this turn. When a minion is played off a prophecy, do not resolve its PERSISTENT: effect this turn. Twice-Dead Prophet has no maximum life.

When the nemesis deck is empty, the players lose.
nemeses.setup:

When playing with 1/2/3/4 players, Twice-Dead Prophet gains 2/2/1/0 nemesis tokens.

nemeses.unleash:
